page: Microsoft Azure L8as_v5 is a member of the Lasv5 server family, utilizing x86_64 AMD processors and running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. This virtual machine features 8 dedicated vCPUs and 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It is equipped with 1920 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, providing high-speed local disk access for storage-intensive operations.

The hardware profile of the L8as_v5 emphasizes a high density of local storage paired with a substantial memory allocation per core. This configuration offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring significant local scratch space or high-speed caching without the need to provision external storage volumes. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities, though the instance does not include GPU acceleration or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the combination of 1920 GB of local storage, Premium Storage capability, and 64.0 GB of memory, the L8as_v5 is engineered for storage-heavy and database workloads. It is highly suitable for relational databases, NoSQL databases, big data analytics, and transactional applications that benefit from low-latency local storage and a high memory-to-vCPU ratio.
